digest.text:
Texas Polls Tracker, Saturday, October 10, 2026

Talarico 71% to win the Senate seat on a polling average of D+3.4. Hinojosa 40% for governor. Democrats 74% to control the U.S. Senate, 86% for the House, 3% for the Texas House.

WHAT MOVED
- Idaho Senate: The Economist moved Safe R → Likely R
- Iowa Senate: Silver Bulletin moved Lean D → Tossup
- Louisiana Senate: Silver Bulletin moved Solid R → Likely R
- TX-2 (U.S. House): new poll — Impact Research (through 2026-10-04): R+9.0
- TX U.S. Senate: new poll — Trafalgar Group (through 2026-10-08): D+3.0

TEXAS STATEWIDE
- U.S. Senate: Talarico 71%. Average D+3.4 over 22 polls; latest Trafalgar Group (R) Oct 8 D+3.0.
- Governor: Hinojosa 40%. Average R+1.5 over 18 polls; latest YouGov Oct 5 D+1.0.
- Lieutenant Governor: Goodwin 29%. Average R+3.5 over 4 polls; latest Stratus Intelligence (R) Sep 24 R+5.0.
- Attorney General: Johnson 28%. Average R+3.6 over 4 polls; latest Stratus Intelligence (R) Sep 24 R+5.0.
- Comptroller: Eckhardt 19%. Average R+5.7 over 3 polls; latest Stratus Intelligence (R) Sep 24 R+6.0.
- Railroad Commissioner: Rosenthal 39%. Average R+1.7 over 3 polls; latest Stratus Intelligence Sep 24 R+2.0.
- Land Commissioner: Flores 20%. Average R+5.5 over 3 polls; latest Texas Public Opinion Research Sep 22 R+3.0.
- Agriculture Commissioner: Tucker 24%. Average R+4.5 over 3 polls; latest Stratus Intelligence (R) Sep 24 R+6.0.

TEXAS LEGISLATURE
- Statewide environment R+4.9: legislative generic ballot R+5.4 over 3 polls, down-ballot statewide races R+4.1; a D+8.8 swing from Trump's 2024 margin.
- Texas House: 62 D today; model expects 67.3 D seats, 3% for a Democratic majority (76). Closest: HD-94 46% D (Tilt D), HD-52 41% D (Tilt D), HD-108 39% D (Tilt R), HD-74 61% D (Likely D), HD-112 63% D (Lean D).
- Texas Senate: 12 D today; model expects 11.5 D seats, 0% for a majority (16). Closest: SD-9 54% D (Likely D), SD-19 91% D, SD-21 94% D.

U.S. SENATE
- Control: 74% for Democrats. Expected 51.6 Democratic-caucus seats; 51 needed.
- Closest races: AK 51% D (average D+0.1, 3 polls); IA 52% D (average D+0.3, 5 polls); NE 56% D (average D+1.0, 1 polls); SC 43% D (average R+1.2, 2 polls); TX 62% D (average D+1.8, 7 polls); KS 62% D (average D+2.0, 3 polls); ME 68% D (average D+2.8, 9 polls); ID 28% D (average R+4.0, 1 polls); MI 72% D (average D+3.6, 11 polls); MN 73% D (average D+3.9, 4 polls); OH 74% D (average D+4.0, 7 polls).

U.S. HOUSE
- Control: 86% for Democrats (expected 232.2 seats, 218 needed). Generic ballot D+7.6 over 4 polls.
- Texas seats in play: TX-15 50% D (Tossup, polls D+13.0); TX-23 23% D (Lean R, polls R+2.0); TX-28 77% D (Lean D, polls D+11.0); TX-34 77% D (Lean D, polls D+3.0); TX-35 37% D (Tilt R, polls R+1.0).

COMING UP
- Texas early voting begins: Monday, October 19, 2026 (in 9 days).
- Deadline to apply for a Texas mail ballot: Friday, October 23, 2026 (in 13 days).
- Texas early voting ends: Friday, October 30, 2026 (in 20 days).
- Election Day: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (in 24 days).
